subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public cron status plus the plugin-facing lifecycle classifier/callback in this PR before merge?
rationale: The code path appears like the right shared fix shape, but adding a persisted protocol status and SDK/hook surface is a compatibility and product-contract decision that source review cannot settle.

options.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
options.body: Ask for redacted Discord status/progress proof and explicit maintainer acceptance or upgrade proof for the public `deferred` status and SDK/hook additions before merge.

options.title: Accept The Contract Risk
options.body: Merge on source review, CI, and cron proof alone while intentionally accepting unproven Discord behavior and downstream client/plugin compatibility risk.

options.title: Split The Public Surface
options.body: Pause this branch and split the internal yielded-parent lifecycle repair from the public cron status and SDK contract expansion.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Discord status/progress proof and explicit maintainer acceptance or upgrade proof for the public `deferred` status and SDK/hook additions before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron/protocol/session work makes this the best available routing candidate for the public status and SDK contract decision.
